\
```{r}
#setting up
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
plantdata <- read_csv("plantdata.csv")
```
```{r}
ggplot(plantdata, aes(x=survey_date, y = height_cm, color = pop)) +
  geom_smooth(method = lm, se = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Plant height over time", x = "Date", y = "Height (cm)", color = "Population") +
  ylim(0,75) +
  theme_minimal()
```
\
Above is the graph of height over time with each population type color coded.
\
```{r}
temp <- plantdata |> filter(survey_date == "2023-01-27")
ggplot(plantdata, aes(x = pop, y = height_cm))+
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "height data for 2023-01-27 by population", x = "Population", y = "Height (cm)")
```
\
Above is the boxplot of plant height data for 2023-01-27.
